age.evidence: At the age of seven weeks, rats were bulbectomised... Eight weeks after surgery, on the sixth day of subchronic treatment, pole-jumping experiments were set in.

sex.evidence: For experiments, male Wistar rats (average (Ø) 400 g) (HsdCpb:WU; Harlan Winkelmann, Germany) were used.

dosing.doses_raw: 0.13 mg/kg, subcutaneous, dissolved in isotonic saline, 10 ml/kg
dosing.evidence: Lysergide[(R,R)-tartrate]-anhydrate... was applied for a period of 11 days, once every 24 h (0.13 mg/kg, subcutaneous, dissolved in isotonic saline, 10 ml/kg).

handling.evidence: The paper does not mention a handling protocol.

group_housing.evidence: The animals were housed in groups of five each cage

day_night_flipped.evidence: light/dark cycle 12:12 (light on at 06:00.)... All five sessions were performed at about the same time during the light period.

enrichment_housing.evidence: The paper does not mention environmental enrichment in the home cage.

assays.assay_description: Rats learned to jump onto a pole to avoid foot shock; 10 trials/day over 5 consecutive days. CS = buzzer (80 dB), US = foot shock (0.2-0.4 mA); trial max 20 s, avoidance window ≤4 s. Conditioned avoidances and instrumental escapes were recorded.

application_type.evidence: 0.13 mg/kg, subcutaneous, dissolved in isotonic saline

setup_habituation.evidence: On the first day, rats were allowed five minutes for exploration of the test apparatus, on the following days only one minute was granted.

setup_restrain.evidence: rats had to learn to actively avoid electrical foot stimuli by jumping onto a pole

food_restriction.evidence: Standard testing apparatus; food not accessible in the pole-jumping chamber. Home cage: 'standard food pellets... ad libitum'.

water_restriction.evidence: Standard testing apparatus; water not accessible in the pole-jumping chamber. Home cage: 'tap water ad libitum'.

time_to_assay.evidence: Treatment started five days before the behavioural experiments, and continued till 24 h before decapitation... administration was performed two hours after each test session.

sample_size.evidence: F(3,31) = 6.39, p = 0.002 (denominator df = 31, implies N=35 across 4 groups)

outcomes.summary: Bulbectomised rats showed deficits in both conditioned and instrumental pole-jumping avoidance. Repeated LSD (0.13 mg/kg/d, 11 d) normalised conditioned avoidance learning in bulbectomised rats to sham levels, with a non-significant trend for instrumental escapes. LSD had no effect on sham-operated controls.
outcomes.statistics: Main effects: time F(4,124)=69.04, p=0.000 (conditioned); F(4,124)=43.22, p=0.000 (instrumental); group F(3,31)=6.39, p=0.002 (conditioned); F(3,31)=2.93, p=0.049 (instrumental); time×group F(12,124)=2.62, p=0.004. sham/saline vs bulb/saline: F(1,14)=13.15, p=0.003 (cond); F(1,14)=4.85, p=0.045 (instr). bulb/saline vs bulb/LSD: F(4,56)=2.6, p=0.045 (cond).
outcomes.evidence: The repeated administration of LSD, however, led to a normalisation of conditioned avoidance learning: LSD-treated bulbectomised rats caught up with the sham-operated controls... and significantly differed from their saline treated counterparts (bulb/saline vs bulb/LSD: F(4,56)=2.6, p=0.045).

B1_num_measures.evidence: the numbers of successful escapes (instrumental reactions, ≤ 20 s) and avoidances (conditioned reactions, ≤ 4 s) were recorded.

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Learning was analysed across days (5 sessions), not within a single session.

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: No analysis of behavioural sequences or transitions reported.

B4_ethological.evidence: Measures are learned escape/avoidance latencies, not natural ethological behaviours.

B5_social.evidence: Animals tested individually; no social component.

B6_cognitive.evidence: rats had to learn to actively avoid electrical foot stimuli by jumping onto a pole

B7_automated_classification.evidence: Manual recording of escapes/avoidances; no automated classifier reported.

B8_multivariate.evidence: Separate univariate ANOVAs; no PCA/clustering reported.

E2_shelter.evidence: No shelter or refuge in the pole-jumping apparatus.

E3_bedding.evidence: electrical foot stimulation delivered through stainless steel rods of the test apparatus' floor

E4_nesting.evidence: No nesting material in the test apparatus.

E5_enrichment.evidence: No enrichment objects in the test apparatus.

E6_spatial.evidence: Single chamber with a pole; no distinct compartments.

E8_food_water.evidence: No food or water in the pole-jumping apparatus.

D1_continuity.evidence: On five days in a row, within 10 trials each day... All five sessions were performed at about the same time during the light period.

D2_session_duration.evidence: 10 trials/day, each trial ≤20 s, ITI 30-90 s, plus 1-5 min exploration. Total session ≈10-15 min; paper does not explicitly state session length.

D3_recording_days.evidence: On five days in a row, within 10 trials each day

D4_baseline.evidence: Testing began on the 6th day of subchronic LSD treatment; no pre-drug behavioural baseline recorded.

D5_followup.evidence: Treatment continued till 24 h before decapitation; sessions occurred during dosing, with drug given 2 h after each session.

D6_circadian.evidence: Sessions performed during the light period; each session well under 6 h.

judge_notes: All three candidates agreed this paper contains a single behavioural assay (one-way active avoidance / pole-jumping). Neurochemical receptor binding assays were correctly excluded as non-behavioural.

B2 temporal_dynamics: GLM scored 1 citing repeated-measures ANOVA across days, but rubric defines B2 as WITHIN-session dynamics. Across-day learning curves are between-session comparisons → scored 0, consistent with qwen and gptoss.
D2 session_duration: paper does not explicitly state total session length; estimated ~10-15 min from 10 trials × ≤20s + 30-90s ITI + 1-5 min exploration. Scored 0 (<15 min) with medium confidence.
setup_habituation: scored 'yes' based on explicit 5-min exploration period on day 1 of the apparatus.
time_to_assay: testing occurred ~22 h after the previous dose (drug given 2 h after each session, sessions ~24 h apart) → early_2to24h, ~1440 min.
